source_authority.incident_summary: v2.24-cli-portify halted at spec-fidelity after exhausting a 2-attempt retry budget producing identical output, because the retry re-ran the same prompt against an unchanged roadmap.md (A1b:F-A1b-006). Recurred as the A12 D-family flatline 58->54->54 HIGH over 3 runs. Drove the v5 deviation-analysis + remediate redesign.

invariant: A retry site must EITHER mutate its input between attempts (non-deterministic/LLM step, or remediation that rewrites input -> different content_hash / envelope.findings count) OR carry a `retry_reason: transient_failure_only` annotation. A deterministic step (prompt="", non-LLM) with retry_limit>0 and no transient annotation is the violation.
expected_contract_7_invariant: MUST FAIL pre-fix (a deterministic step carried retry_limit>0 against unchanged input), MUST PASS post-fix (every deterministic roadmap Step carries retry_limit=0; progress comes from bounded convergence with genuine input mutation, not identical-input retries).
